title: Vehicle ownership cost table
description: Array of vehicle documents. Each element is one vehicle variant (brand + model + year + powertrain). Designed for NoSQL: data that is read together is stored together, so each document embeds its full depreciation and maintenance curve. Tax and insurance are out of scope by design.

money.description: Amount in `currency`. Tax and insurance excluded.

ratio.description: Value retained vs purchase.real_cost. Usually <= 1; allow >1 for rare appreciation cases.

checkpointYear.description: Only these checkpoint years are allowed, so every vehicle stays comparable.

source.description: Where the number comes from, e.g. '8891 avg of 12 listings', 'dealer quote 2026-08', 'owner club post', 'example placeholder'.

confidence.description: low = guess / single data point, medium = a few data points, high = many listings or a real quote.

id.description: Stable slug, e.g. 'toyota-corolla-cross-2024-hybrid'. Becomes the document key in a real NoSQL store.

powertrain.description: Split documents by powertrain: depreciation curves differ a lot (esp. bev).

list_price.description: 買入費用: official list price (牌價).

onroad_fees.description: Registration / agent fees to get on the road. Tax and insurance excluded.

real_cost.description: 真實買入費用: what you actually paid = list_price - discounts + onroad_fees. This is the cost basis for every ratio below.

selling_costs.description: 賣出費用: one-time costs paid when you sell (transfer, detailing, platform fee). NOT the sale price itself.

value_checkpoints.description: 自行賣出估價 curve. One entry per checkpoint year; years must be unique and ascending (checked by validate.py).

assumed_km.description: Odometer km assumed at this checkpoint. Should sit inside years * [annual_km_low, annual_km_high]. Market prices are quoted per mileage band, so record what mileage the estimate assumes.

private_sale_price.description: 自行賣出估價: expected private-sale price at this age/mileage.

dealer_tradein_price.description: Optional: dealer trade-in offer (車商收購價), usually lower than private sale.

retention_ratio.description: DERIVED = private_sale_price / purchase.real_cost. Recomputed by validate.py --fix.

depreciation_amount.description: DERIVED = purchase.real_cost - private_sale_price. Recomputed by validate.py --fix.

as_of.description: When this estimate was taken. Re-estimate roughly yearly.

maintenance.description: 保養粗估費用 curve, aligned to the same checkpoint years.

period_cost.description: Maintenance spent SINCE the previous checkpoint (not cumulative).

cumulative_cost.description: DERIVED = running sum of period_cost. Recomputed by validate.py --fix.

major_items.description: Big-ticket items in this period, e.g. 'tires x4', 'brake pads', 'hybrid battery check'.

cost_summary.description: DERIVED table, fully regenerated by validate.py --fix. total_cost = depreciation_amount + maintenance cumulative_cost + selling_costs.total.
